hero.title: Project Structure
hero.intro: Care@Home is structured into six interconnected Work Packages (WPs), covering monitoring, technology development, AI, validation, and project management.

packages.title: Identification of Critical Monitoring Parameters
packages.description: Define key physical activities, vital signs, daily routines (ADLs), and environmental factors that reflect health and independence.

packages.title: Contactless IoT System Development
packages.description: Develop a non-invasive IoT infrastructure using Nearable & Airable Smart Sensors (NASS) for continuous data collection.

packages.title: Localized Sensitive Data Processing (TinyML)
packages.description: Develop privacy-preserving AI models using TinyML for real-time, local data processing on edge devices.

packages.title: AI-Based Monitoring Ecosystem
packages.description: Integrate system components into a complete AI-powered monitoring ecosystem and validate performance under controlled conditions.

packages.title: System Evaluation & Validation
packages.description: Evaluate system performance across diverse populations, including nursing homes and private households in multiple countries.

packages.title: Project Management & Communication
packages.description: Ensure coordination, quality assurance, ethical compliance, and dissemination of project results across stakeholders.

steps.label: WP1 → WP2
steps.text: Define what to monitor → build sensing infrastructure

steps.label: WP2 → WP3 → WP4
steps.text: Collect data → process locally → integrate into full system

steps.label: WP4 → WP5
steps.text: Deploy system → evaluate in real-world environments

items.title: Validated Solution
items.text: Tested across real users and environments
